named-query.name: File.findByHashAndBucket
named-query.query: SELECT f FROM PhysicalFile f WHERE f.contentHash = :hash AND f.bucket = :bucket

named-query.name: File.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT f FROM File f WHERE f.uid = :uid

named-query.name: File.isOrphanPhysicalFile
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(f) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM File f WHERE f.physicalFile = :physicalFile
